buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Police Verification. Contractor will be responsible to ensure that the staff employed by him are security cleared by Police Station of the worker’ s residential area. Police verification is to be submitted for all empl oyees at least 10 days prior to commencement of work. The Contractor will also ensure that no person em ployed by him had been/is involved in anti-national activities. 2. The Contractor shall be obliged and solely responsible to comply with all statutory requirements in resp

ect of the manpower engaged by him and The Commanding Officer, ICGS Vizhinjam shall not be a party to any dispute arising out of such deployment by the contractor. 3. The manpower deployed by the contractor under this contract shall be the employees of the contractor and in no circumstances shall ever have any claim of employment with the Commanding Officer, ICGS Viz hinjam. 4. No Worker shall be less than 18 yrs and more than 45 yrs of age.They should also be healthy and having adequate experience/training for conservancy duties. 5. The agency will ensure that staff deployed by them are only Indian nationals and are selected after due verification of antecedents required from the police authorities of the concerned locality. 6. Verification of character and antecedents of the personnel should be completed within a month’s time fr om taking up appointment. 7. The staff deployed by contractor shall be in distinct/ neat uniform consisting of apron and nurse uniform with head gear with logo of firm embossed. Sample of uniform are to be approved by the Commanding Offi cer, ICGS Vizhinjam at least 10 days prior to commencement of contract. In order to maintain neat and cle an uniforms at all times, at two sets of uniforms are to be issued to each employee. Gate passes for enteri ng Coast Guard premises for these personnel will be issued by Commanding Officer, Indian Coast Guard st ation Vizhinjam. These passes shall be surrendered when they are no longer required or aft er completion of the period of agreement. 8. Application for gate passes shall be submitted immediately on appointment. In case, staff is proceeding on long leave/suspended/dismissed from service or leaves the job, identity cards must be withdrawn and d eposited with the Executive Officer Coast Guard station Vizhinjam by the Agency. 9. The successful bidder’s representative will meet the Executive officer/Officer nominated by the contact Operating Authority on a “need basis” to review the performance of manpower. 10. The agency is bound to meet prevailing rate of minimum wages which are fixed for particular employm ent by the Central Govt. Seller will have to absorb extra expenditure which may occur owing to revision of applicable minimum pay for the higher side by the Govt. 11. All the statutory benefits and mandatory allowances in vogue as per Central Government like EPF etc. r elated to the staff as per Government of India and supervisor shall be met by the Agency. No third party in between Indian Coast Guard and Contracted agency to be involved in between to avoid loss of exchequer to Gov. and pay benefits to the employees which may finally lead to compromise in quality of service/qualified staff. 12. Individuals being engaged by the agency at the premises of the ICGS Vizhinjam under this contract sha ll be strictly the employee of the agency under their control and they shall have no right for regular emplo yment or any other benefits from the Coast Guard on the basis of their contract services with the Coast Gu ard. Their engagement with Coast Guard will terminate on expiry of the contract. 13. The agency reserves the right to remove any of their conservancy staff (for a replacement) from the pr emises of the Coast Guard area due to any unforeseen administrative reasons at any time and if demande d by the Coast Guard, within a week’s time. 14. The intimation is to be given of any trespassing, loss/ theft , fire or any abnormal incidents to the Com manding Officer, ICGS Vizhinjam. 15. The Contractor is to ensure that staff is not in intoxicated condition while on duty and they will have no access to the Administrative building / family quarters/ Mess/ Canteen and other office premises until and unless essentially required. They will have no facility/ amenities that are extended to Coast Guard personn el and their families and the contractor is to make their own arrangements for the same at their own cost. 16. The minimum educational qualification of staff should be Graduate in B.S.C. nursing or diploma in nurs ing. Agency to ensure only female nurse has to be employed. she should be able to communicate in Hindi or English. 17. The contractor should conduct meeting with his employee once in a quarter for their welfare issues an d for instructions for motivation. (a) Not allow or permit their employee to participate in any trade union a ctivities or agitations in the premises of the Government of India/ elsewhere. (b) Attend to all the complain ts/ suggestions/ instructions given by the Commanding Officer Coast Guard station Vizhinjam or his author ised representative and comply with them as early as possible to the satisfaction of the Commanding Offic er Coast Guard Station Vizhinjam. (c) Bag and baggage connected with the staff shall be liable for physical check both at the time of entry an d exit out of the Area by the Coast Guard Police/ Commanding Officer C oast Guard station Vizhinjam or an y other person nominated by him. 18. Any theft or damages caused by the agency personnel shall be borne by the Agency and the matter be investigated. 19. Commanding Officer, ICGS Vizhinjam will not be responsible for any injury or loss of life of any of the A gency personnel that may take place while on duties. Any compensating expenditure towards treatment fo r injury or loss of life shall be the sole responsibility of the Agency. The Agency is advised to avail the best value for money insurance scheme as per existing rules for smooth functioning. 20. Agency will take responsibility to change the staff on demand by the Commanding Officer Coast Guard station Vizhinjam within 24 hours if the allotted personnel detailed for duties commit acts like: (i) Sleeping while on duty(,ii) Negligent performance of duty, (iii) Dishonesty (iv) Deserting/ absent from place of duty,

(v) Indulging in illegal activities, which are jeopardizing the interests of the GoI. 21. The personnel to be employed under this agreement shall be suitably trained in their respective duties 22. The representative officers/supervisors from Agency shall carry out surprise checks at the site in order to confirm the e desired performance of the conservancy personnel as demanded by ICGS Vizhinjam. 23. The Agency shall maintain an attendance Register which shall be verified and countersigned daily by t he Commanding Officer Coast Guard Station Vizhinjam or any other person nominated by him. 24. Transport and medical facilities shall be provided by the Contractor to his employees. 25. Staff nurse employed should be from Trivandrum district only. 26. Successful bidder must direct atleast 03 optional choice for staff nurse for interviewed by Station Medi cal Officer, before commencement of Contract. . 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 6. Generic Registration / Empanelment Requirement: Contract shall be awarded to only such sellers , who are registered / empanelled / approved / enlisted with MSE for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid opening date. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reasonable procedure.) 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of The Commanding officer, ICGS Vizhinjam payable at at Trivandrum . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.

8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of concerned seller A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
